claim: The original monic quartic j-algebra has relative differential module exactly Model/(p-prime), with full annihilator and its transported original Laurent ideal explicitly factored.

obligations.name: Original monic presentation and coefficient ring
obligations.required_input: The relative differential calculation must refer to the actual j-algebra, not the absolute Q differentials or a new polynomial with the same degree.
obligations.constructed_input: Base is the original Q[j], Model is the unchanged AdjoinRoot of ThreeJMonicAlgebra318.polynomial, and evaluation is aeval at its original root.
obligations.justification: evaluation_mk, evaluation_surjective and evaluation_polynomial identify the entire polynomial quotient map with the actual AdjoinRoot map. All derivations and differential modules are relative to Base.

obligations.name: Exact derivative quotient
obligations.required_input: The quotient used as a detector must contain precisely the image of the actual monic derivative.
obligations.constructed_input: delta is evaluation of the original polynomial derivative; derivativeIdeal is its principal ideal in Model and DifferentialQuotient is Model modulo that ideal.
obligations.justification: quotient_delta is proved using ideal membership. The full quotient is used, without passing to a radical, to closed points, or to a residue field.

obligations.name: Descent through the quartic relation
obligations.required_input: Polynomial differentiation is not automatically well defined on AdjoinRoot. Its value in the chosen target must vanish on the entire kernel.
obligations.constructed_input: polynomialDifferential differentiates and then applies the original evaluation and derivative quotient maps. descends checks every kernel polynomial, using original p divisibility and the derivative product rule.
obligations.justification: For q=p*r both terms vanish: p itself is zero in Model and p-prime is zero in DifferentialQuotient. LinearMap.liftOfSurjective then gives a well-defined Base-linear map on the whole Model.

obligations.name: Genuine relative derivation and detector
obligations.required_input: A linear map alone cannot invoke the universal property of Kaehler differentials.
obligations.constructed_input: quotientDerivation proves the one and Leibniz conditions on arbitrary original Model elements by surjective polynomial representatives. quotientDerivation_t proves its value on the original root is one.
obligations.justification: The induced Model-linear detector from Omega to DifferentialQuotient is therefore an actual universal differential map and distinguishes every nonzero coefficient class.

obligations.name: Generation and exact kernel
obligations.required_input: An annihilating polynomial is only one inclusion and cannot establish the differential-module presentation.
obligations.constructed_input: generator sends a to a*dt; generator_surjective proves every relative differential lies in its range. derivative_relation supplies delta*dt=0, while detector_generator recovers the original quotient class of every coefficient.
obligations.justification: generator_kernel proves both inclusions: the derivative ideal kills dt, and any coefficient killing dt maps to zero in the exact derivative quotient. The converse is not inferred from dimension or closed-point counts.

obligations.name: Full module presentation and annihilator
obligations.required_input: The desired object must be the entire relative Kaehler module, not a selected family of its elements.
obligations.constructed_input: differentialEquiv constructs DifferentialQuotient isomorphic as a Model-module to KaehlerDifferential Base Model. annihilates_iff identifies all scalars killing the entire module with derivativeIdeal.
obligations.justification: The quotient-kernel equivalence consumes the proved generator surjectivity and exact kernel. Surjectivity then extends the generator relation to every differential.

obligations.name: Exact original Laurent ideal and multiplicity
obligations.required_input: The monic model must be connected to the original Laurent coordinate with the actual j scalar action, retaining multiplicities.
obligations.constructed_input: originalDifferentialIdeal is the image of derivativeIdeal under the already constructed coordinate equivalence. original_coordinate_relation retains S*(T+243)^2*D.
obligations.justification: remove_laurent_unit proves equality of principal ideals using both T*S=1 directions already present in the exact derivative identities. original_differential_ideal_factorization gives the ideal product (T+243)^2*(D), without taking radicals.

obligations.name: Analytic comparison and scheme boundary
obligations.required_input: The new algebraic calculation must not silently promote the earlier analytic divisor to a global scheme divisor.
obligations.constructed_input: The89-source predecessor retains the exhaustive actual analytic divisor, original compact comparison and derivative-open evaluation identity. The two new sources supply the missing exact relative monic differential presentation on the Laurent model.
obligations.justification: The transported ideal is explicitly defined via the verified algebra equivalence. No new unproved identification with a globally glued differential sheaf, Cartier divisor, different, or literal Laurent Kaehler module is asserted. Extending the presentation to both source cusp charts remains a separate task.

obligations.name: Validation, exact CI repair and source-genus distinction
obligations.required_input: Source genus, divisor location and validation must not be conflated with a different degree-four curve.
obligations.constructed_input: The map is the actual genus-zero projective-line self-map. Riemann-Hurwitz reads-2=4*(-2)+6. Source weights2,2,1,1 and pushforward weights2,2,2 are distinguished. Eighty-eight predecessors are unchanged; RationalPairGluing318 removes two dead tails after congr1 already closes the goals.
obligations.justification: The exact run42582121938 c4cd4ae failure is preserved separately. No local Lean was run. There is no claim about a genus-four contact curve, integral extension through characteristic3, general PEL producer or full318/326 completion.
